errors.evidence: The reference states that the Y-axis is not visualized but represented by two lines; the machine description incorrectly implies that the Y-axis has units of years.
The description omits essential details about the Y-axis values and their representation.
The description does not mention the color of the lines or that one line represents the number of contracts and the other represents the total value in millions of BGN.
The purpose of the chart, which is to show the dynamics of contracts, is not clearly stated.
